hero.sub: We handle sourcing, factory inspection, private label and logistics end-to-end, so you know who produces your order before it ships. Free quotation within 24 hours.
trust: Fee quoted separately from third-party costs

exports.label: 2025 exports of the product groups we cover (UN Comtrade)

services.title: One team from sourcing to your port
services.lead: Pick a single service or let us run the whole chain. You always know which factory produces your order.

industries.title: Where Türkiye is a strong sourcing base
industries.lead: Export figures are the sum of the linked UN Comtrade values for the product groups on each page.

steps.title: Request and quotation
steps.text: Tell us product, quantity and target market; your quotation arrives within 24 hours.

steps.title: Supplier shortlist
steps.text: We screen Turkish manufacturers on documents, capacity and export history.

steps.title: Samples and inspection
steps.text: Samples are compared, and an independent inspector checks the factory.

steps.title: Production follow-up
steps.text: We track the schedule and report progress at every step.

steps.title: Logistics and customs
steps.text: Export customs and freight are handled through to your port.

partners.title: Verified Turkish Partners
partners.empty: Our first Verified Turkish Partners are coming soon.

cta.title: Tell us what you need. We quote within 24 hours.
cta.lead: Product, quantity, destination and deadline are enough to start. Our fee is quoted separately from third-party costs.

aside.title: Free quotation in 24h
aside.text: Send product, quantity, destination and deadline. You receive a free quotation within 24 hours.

page.preparing: Product pages for this category are being prepared. Send your requirements now and we will quote in 24h.
